DataTable.disabled: No independent disabled prop, state handling, or editable-root behavior.
DataTable.readOnly: Pure data renderer; selection cells are separate Checkbox controls.
DataTable.validation: No field validity contract; loading/error are data-fetch states.
DataTable.uncontrolled: sort/onSort is controlled; no defaultSort or component-managed record selection.

TreeTable.disabled: Root has no disabled prop; loading only blocks a pending branch.
TreeTable.readOnly: Root has no readOnly prop; expansion is its own operation.
TreeTable.validation: No field validity contract. Async child failure is error, not validation.
